visualCharacteristics.purpose: Short full-width promotional strip with text and a CTA over a background image
visualCharacteristics.summary: Short full-width background-image strip with centered inline text and CTA button
visualCharacteristics.layout: Low-height full-bleed strip; background image covers the strip; text and CTA button are centered on one line from 600px and stacked on mobile

contentPattern.structure: a background image (own row/cell or with the text; optional second image = mobile background), a short line of text and a CTA link (rendered as a button)
contentPattern.source: Background image + short text + Login Now CTA

usage: Login/loyalty prompts and short promotional messages between sections.
reuseGuidance: Use for one-line messages. For a tall hero with a headline use hero; for rotating heroes use carousel-hero.
